<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The file is a standard Arch Linux post_install hook for the synshell-core-bin package. It contains only echo statements that print informational messages in Russian to the user after installation, suggesting how to select the synshell session in a display manager (GDM, SDDM), optionally enable synlogin.service, and enable synfsd for file change journaling. There are no network requests, no code execution, no obfuscation, no data exfiltration, and no system modifications performed by the script itself. The systemctl commands mentioned are merely suggestions printed to stdout, not executed by the hook. This is consistent with normal AUR packaging practices.
</details>
